resources.string: Control Atlas background playback and view live track artwork directly from your home screen.
Glance at your current account balance, savings pockets, and pending transactions directly from your home screen.
Glance at your active expedition, live GPS distance, mountain elevation, and upcoming treks directly from your home screen.

With your explicit consent, Atlas observes window identity changes to detect the Google/Gemini assistant overlay you confirm. It attempts to dismiss that overlay and open Atlas voice. It does not read screen contents, capture Google transcripts, or use the microphone while idle. Manually opening that overlay can also trigger Atlas. Disable this service in Accessibility settings at any time.
